decisions.statement: A reading naming no slug reaches every service.
A slug no page is filed under is refused by name.
A page that will not load refuses rather than reading as no service.
A page missing a value a service needs refuses rather than reading as a service.
One page that refuses refuses the whole reading.
A value stated as the wrong sort is read as though the value were not stated.
Whether a service is told is read from that service's page.
An option this system does not have is dropped rather than carried through.
A service has one command line, which runs the runner and names that service.
The command line is composed the same way for every service the loader is not named for.
A service the loader is named for starts the loader and names itself to it.
The tree a deploy pinned reaches no command line the loader composes.
A service is named there by its slug rather than by the file holding its code.
The file that command line runs is answered for on its own as well.
What a page spells of how it runs reaches no command line.

definition: the workstation service a page states, read from the index and the page
